name: Calendar Date Selection
task: Fix the failing test in tests/calendar-date.spec.ts. The test needs to select the 1st day of the current month from a calendar widget. Currently it's trying to fill the date input directly which doesn't work. The calendar requires clicking the calendar icon, navigating to the current month, and selecting day 1.
passCriteria: Opens calendar widget by clicking icon/button
Does NOT use keyboard input or fill() on date field
failCriteria: Uses fill() or type() on calendar input
Uses keyboard shortcuts to enter date
